_comment: A hollow tree's own planting (`HollowTreesField`), kept to its biomes by the last filter and to no word by `does_not_have_a_word`. Tried over the heights its biome reaches in a tree of any size, and the biome keeps what lands inside one.
Vines on every face of the wood they can hang from, tried at every height: a vine places only where it has a face beside it.
